Red Lobster Daily Specials You Need to Try Today

If you’re a seafood lover searching for a delicious deal on your favorite dishes, Red Lobster’s daily deals menu is one of the best promotions you can enjoy. From shrimp feasts to Crabfest, Red Lobster’s weekday specials make it easy to plan your next dine-in or to-go order. This guide breaks down everything about Red Lobster’s new daily deals, happy hour, seasonal promotions like Crabfest, and how to get the most out of every Red Lobster restaurant visit — whether dining in, taking out, or ordering delivery directly from redlobster.com.

Why Red Lobster’s Daily Deals Are So Popular

Red Lobster is known for serving delicious seafood available each weekday at a great value. From endless shrimp to wild-caught cod served with fries and coleslaw, these daily deals give guests plenty of reasons to come back every weekday.

What Are Red Lobster’s New Daily Deals?

Red Lobster’s new daily deals feature a different deal on delicious seafood every day, Monday through Friday. Each dish comes with their famous Cheddar Bay Biscuit, a choice of side, and unbeatable pricing that makes a night out feel like a celebration without breaking the bank.

Red Lobster Daily Deals Menu: What to Expect

Below is a breakdown of the current Red Lobster daily deals menu — prices and availability may vary by location, so always check with your local Red Lobster restaurant.

Day Daily Deal Price Details
Monday Ultimate Endless Shrimp $22.99 Mix and match shrimp favorites, served with your choice of side and Cheddar Bay Biscuits.
Tuesday Two for Tuesday $49.99 Two Maine Lobster Tails paired with wood-grilled shrimp skewers and sides.
Wednesday Whole Lobster Wednesday $22.99 Whole lobster with crispy potatoes and garlic shrimp scampi.
Thursday Throwback Thursday $17.99 Back to the Good Old Days with Walt’s Favorite Shrimp and a fountain beverage.
Friday Fish Fry Friday $17.99 Hand-battered wild-caught cod served with fries and coleslaw.

Prices are subject to applicable taxes and gratuities and may vary by participating locations. Always confirm local pricing and details at your nearest Red Lobster.

Red Lobster Happy Hour Specials

Besides the daily deals, Red Lobster’s Happy Hour is another great way to score seafood for less. At many locations, you can enjoy discounted drinks, appetizers, and small plates. Red Lobster Happy Hour times vary by restaurant and location, but they’re typically available in the afternoon on weekdays.

Popular Happy Hour Picks:

  • Garlic Shrimp Scampi
  • Parrot Isle Jumbo Coconut Shrimp
  • Crispy potatoes with dipping sauce
  • Favorite shrimp and a fountain beverage

Seasonal Promotions: Crabfest and More

Every year, Red Lobster brings back Crabfest, featuring snow crab legs, Maine lobster tail paired with shrimp skewers, and more special seafood dishes. During Crabfest, you can enjoy new daily deals with a crab twist, from steamed snow crab legs to ultimate seafood combos with steak and wood-grilled shrimp.

Red Lobster’s Ultimate Endless Shrimp

The Ultimate Endless Shrimp is a fan favorite deal available for a limited time during specific promotions. Guests can mix and match shrimp dishes like:

  • Garlic Shrimp Scampi
  • Wood-Grilled Shrimp Skewers
  • Walt’s Favorite Shrimp
  • Crispy Shrimp Alfredo Linguini

Availability may vary — always check the official Red Lobster Endless Shrimp details.

Red Lobster Rewards and How to Earn Points

If you love Red Lobster’s daily deals, joining Red Lobster Rewards makes sense. You earn points on every order — whether you dine in, order to-go, or get delivery directly. Redeem points for discounts on your next visit.

Pro Tip: Sign up for email updates so you never miss a promotion or special deal.

Red Lobster Daily Specials: Days to Plan For

Knowing when your favorite deal is available helps you plan ahead. Here’s a quick cheat sheet for specials every weekday:

Monday: Start the week with endless shrimp!
Tuesday: Treat yourself to Two for Tuesday with Maine Lobster Tails.
Wednesday: Get over hump day with Whole Lobster Wednesday.
Thursday: Throwback Thursday brings you Walt’s Favorite Shrimp for a nostalgic bite.
Friday: Wrap up your week with Fish Fry Friday.

Available All Day and For Dine-In

These daily deals are typically available all day for dine-in guests and sometimes for delivery or to-go. Always call your local Red Lobster to confirm availability — especially due to changing hours or local guidelines.

Must-Try Menu Items Besides Daily Deals

Even when it’s not a weekday deal, Red Lobster’s regular menu is packed with seafood specials:

  • Maine Lobster Tail: Often paired with steak or shrimp.
  • Snow Crab Legs: Served steamed with garlic butter.
  • Wild-Caught Cod: Lightly hand-battered and fried.
  • Parrot Isle Jumbo Coconut Shrimp: Sweet, crispy, and delicious.
  • Steak & Lobster Combos: For surf and turf fans.
  • Garlic Shrimp Scampi Linguini: A creamy pasta favorite.

Dining Experience: What to Expect

Red Lobster is a casual chain known for great value and a friendly atmosphere. Whether you’re catching up with family on Monday through Friday or enjoying a weekend seafood feast, you’ll always get:

  • Fresh Cheddar Bay Biscuits
  • Great deals at Red Lobster for lunch and dinner
  • Friendly service
  • Safe dining experience for dine-in or delivery

Locations and Ordering Options

You can find Red Lobster restaurants in most cities across the U.S. and Canada. Use RedLobster.com to find a location, check local daily deals, and order delivery or to-go. Many deals apply to delivery directly from Red Lobster, but availability may vary.

Pro Tips to Maximize Your Red Lobster Deals

✅ Check your local Red Lobster’s site for the latest daily deals.
✅ Join Red Lobster Rewards to stack points on your orders.
✅ Visit during Happy Hour for drink and appetizer specials.
✅ Combine weekday daily deals with Crabfest for seasonal savings.
✅ Order ahead for to-go or delivery — perfect if you’re craving seafood at home.

Frequently Asked Questions

Are Red Lobster’s daily deals available for delivery?
Many daily deals are available for dine-in only, but some locations offer delivery through RedLobster.com. Always check the details for your area.

Do daily deals include Cheddar Bay Biscuits?
Yes! Most deals come with the famous biscuit — the best part for many guests.

What days have the best deals at Red Lobster?
It depends on what you crave: Mondays are great for endless shrimp, Wednesdays for whole lobster, and Fridays for hand-battered fish fry.

Is Crabfest part of the daily deals?
Not exactly. Crabfest is a seasonal event with unique dishes but can overlap with weekday deals during the promotion.

How do I know my location’s prices?
Prices can vary slightly by location and local taxes. Always check your local Red Lobster restaurant’s page online.

Back to the Good Old Days: Walt’s Favorite Shrimp

If you love a throwback, Throwback Thursday with Walt’s Favorite Shrimp is a must-try. This classic dish is hand-battered, fried to golden perfection, and served with crispy potatoes, fries, and a fountain beverage.

Final Thoughts: Make the Most of Red Lobster’s Daily Specials

From Ultimate Endless Shrimp to the famous Fish Fry Friday, Red Lobster’s weekday specials offer seafood fans unbeatable value. Whether you’re craving snow crab legs, a Maine Lobster Tail paired with steak, or a simple garlic shrimp scampi, there’s a delicious option for every weekday.

Plan Your Next Seafood Night

Now that you know about Red Lobster’s new daily deals, happy hour, Crabfest, and weekday promotions, you can enjoy seafood on any budget. So grab your family, call your local restaurant, or place your order for dine-in, to-go, or delivery directly — and treat yourself to a dining experience that makes every day feel special.

Ready to eat? Check your local Red Lobster’s daily deals menu, sign up for rewards, and enjoy your favorite seafood for less — every weekday!
